character_facts: Aghnar is pursuing revenge and is capable of long-term deception, direct combat, and mental confrontation.
Aghnar controls at least one Cetacyborg by mental command.
Aghnar sacrifices one arm as part of his plan to kill Jejoh.
Princess Oda helps Aghnar, is captured and used in a ritual setting, and later joins him spiritually or mentally in the final confrontation.
Oda is left seemingly lifeless after expending herself in the battle.
Jejoh is depicted as a hideous, powerful being tied to the witches' power structure.

lore_facts: The Shabda-Oud seek Oda for breeding purposes.
The witches' asteroid is defended or inhabited by Cetacyborgs.
Jejoh is a monstrous god-being associated with the witches and is initially invulnerable to ordinary attack.
Magon apes can be deployed from a Cetacyborg and used as a swarm force.
Aghnar had OKO mini-bombs hidden in his arm, which could detonate inside Jejoh.
The elder witches can focus their energy into destructive mental attacks.
The Metabunker is a place Aghnar may need to reach in order to save Oda.
Six Cetacyborgs still guard the asteroid after the described battle.
plot_events: Aghnar wins Princess Oda's trust and she agrees to help him seek revenge.
Aghnar disguises himself among witches and has Oda delivered to the Shabda-Oud, who want her for breeding.
On the witches' asteroid, Oda is chained to an altar and the god Jejoh appears.
Aghnar orders a Cetacyborg under his control to release a swarm of Magon apes while he attacks Jejoh.
Jejoh is unaffected by direct attacks, so Aghnar lets Jejoh devour his bomb-rigged arm, causing an internal explosion.
Jejoh's destruction and the collapse of the witches' power allow the apes to overrun the asteroid.
Aghnar, after losing an arm, confronts the elder witches mentally and Oda joins him in the battle of minds.
The elder witches are destroyed and Aghnar's revenge is achieved.
Oda is left lifeless or spiritually burned out after the final battle.
Aghnar may still be able to save Oda if he can return to the Metabunker by breaking through the six remaining Cetacyborg guards.
